unresolved_items.description: New unresolved questions or ambiguities to register

raw_question.description: The raw question or ambiguity as discovered (will be reformulated into a specific question)

context.description: Where this question came from and which artifacts it affects

suggested_criticality.description: Optional suggested criticality — will be validated against impact

existing_open_questions_path.description: Optional path to existing Open_Questions.md for deduplication and ID sequencing

next_id.description: Next OQ number to use (e.g., 5 means next ID is OQ-005). Computed from existing register if not provided.
